# CKW Elements

CKW Elements is CKW's design system for React applications. It ships design tokens, icons, and React components as npm packages.

## Primary Resources

- Full AI guide: llms-full.txt
- Design summary: DESIGN.md
- Story index: index.json
- Token CSS: tokens/tokens.css
- Token JavaScript: tokens/tokens.js
- Token JSON: tokens/tokens.json
- React prototyping skill: skills/ckw-prototyping.md
- React component skill: skills/ckw-components.md
- CKW Figma design system: https://www.figma.com/design/wGx1Y74QZIsy40UATyN6bI/%F0%9F%92%A0-CKW-Elements-%C2%B7-Design-System

## Packages

- `@ckwag/elements-tokens`: CSS custom properties, JavaScript token exports, and DTCG JSON.
- `@ckwag/elements-icons`: React SVG icons (24px, `currentColor`). Use named imports such as `IconSearch`. Names are kebab-case (`arrow-left-circle-filled`); renamed icons stay available as deprecated aliases until the next major version.
- `@ckwag/elements`: React components that use CKW semantic tokens: Badge, Button, InlineMessage, InputField, LoadingSpinner, PasswordInput, SegmentedControl, Select.

## Core Rules

- Import `@ckwag/elements-tokens/tokens.css` once in the application entry point.
- Use semantic tokens like `var(--interactive-primary)`, not primitive tokens like `var(--color-green-600)`, in product components.
- Prop values are lowercase in code (`variant="primary"`, `size="large"`, `status="error"`).
- CKW brand color is green. Do not make primary UI blue.
- CKW brand font is Gotham via `var(--font-family-brand), sans-serif`.
- React TSX files in this repository must keep `import React from 'react';`.

## React Usage

```bash
npm install @ckwag/elements-tokens @ckwag/elements-icons @ckwag/elements
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { IconSearch } from '@ckwag/elements-icons';
import { Button, InlineMessage, InputField, Select } from '@ckwag/elements';
import '@ckwag/elements-tokens/tokens.css';
```

```css
@import '@ckwag/elements-tokens/tokens.css';
```
